valueChoice.note: The app needs one amount per event. The book gives ranges and does not say how to pick inside one. Min and max are stored; the picking rule is open.

fumble.note: Book: full loss plus 1 extra point and immediate complications. Needs a stored rule.

openItems.summary: Amounts inside ranges, trauma-check DC, half-loss rounding, partial success on anomalous damage.
Every amount can be changed by the Handler before it is shown to players (R's ruling).
